notes: Wingman can now apply Cisco WLC patches — SMU, APSP and APDP — not just full-image upgrades. It recognizes the patch type from the file, confirms the patch's base release matches what the controller is running, and tells you exactly what will reload before it touches anything.

Patches use the right deterministic install commands: APSP/APDP apply in one step (an AP Service Pack reloads only the APs that need the new image, rolling, while the controller stays up; an AP Device Pack reloads nothing), and a controller SMU activates then commits — flagging whether it's a cold patch (reloads the box) or hot (no reload).
Every patch step still asks for your confirmation and the end state is read live from "show install summary" — Wingman never claims a patch is committed without seeing it.
